inspiration: Layered area backdrop: ar0100.png (1600x1152) sits beside ar0100.wed, .tis, .mos and .are, so the art layer and the walk-or-block layer are separate files (demo/override/). Keep: art and passability as two layers. Change: our own architecture and palette.
Equipment icon family at 30x30 (demo/override/ston**.png, CC-BY-3.0): one frame for every slot with one silhouette per slot. Keep the frame and silhouette rules. Change the motifs and colours.
Gem as a hero item: ruby128.png (128x128) beside ruby32.bam and the item definition ruby.itm. Keep: a large master icon plus a small version. Change: the cut, colour and setting.

Context pointer set: 48 cursor files at 33x33 (demo/override/cursor00.png to cursor47.png, CC-BY-SA-3.0). Meaning of each state not read per file. Keep: a small pointer that changes state. Change: the shape language.
Ground container for loot: grndloot.bam and contgrnd.bam (CC-BY-SA-3.0). Keep: a low sack on the ground as a drop marker. Change: silhouette and colour.
Footstep variant pool: fs_dirta.ogg to fs_dirti.ogg (CC-BY-3.0) picked at random per step. Keep: a pool of short variants. Change: surface type, pitch range and clip length.

Data-first: classes.2da, itemtype.2da, action.ids, avatars.2da and the .cre and .itm files carry names and rules, so content can be data-driven. Keep the table-driven approach. Do not copy names or rows.

briefs.label: Walled town backdrop with a passability layer
briefs.why: Reads at 375 wide as a wall line and roof tops. Signature sound: a zone ambient loop (AMB_D18.ogg, CC-BY-SA-3.0 per REUSE.toml:138-140). The walk-or-block layer is data, so the backdrop can stay pre-rendered.
keep: pre-rendered backdrop with a separate walk-or-block layer
wall-line silhouette that frames the play area
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: new layout grid and street plan
palette and architecture of our own (target about 20-30 percent resemblance)
ambient loop replaced by our own sound

briefs.label: Stone-set slot icon family
briefs.why: A 30x30 slot icon reads in a bag grid on a phone. One silhouette per slot keeps the inventory scannable.
keep: one fixed frame size for every slot
a single rim colour for the set
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: our own silhouettes for each slot
our own motifs and metal palette
different rim treatment (not the donor rim)

briefs.label: Faceted gem hero icon
briefs.why: One bright glint reads at small size. The 128 master with a small version works for item tooltips and bag slots.
keep: one bright highlight as the signature
large master icon with a small version
gem as the hero item of its family
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: new cut and facet count
glint placed differently from the donor

briefs.label: Ground sack loot container
briefs.why: A low sack on the ground reads as lootable from a distance. Signature effect: a short settle on drop.
keep: low sack silhouette on the ground
drop as a marker of loot
one clear shape with no detail needed at range
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: new tie or clasp

briefs.label: Nine-variant dirt footstep pool
briefs.why: Variety without new art. Signature sound: a dirt step chosen at random from a pool each time.
keep: pool of short variants picked at random
change: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy: our own surface sounds
different pitch range and clip length
pool size and variant character of our own
